articles.expand: MUFG’s call puts the risk squarely on the New Zealand dollar: with a hike almost fully priced, the currency’s G10 outperformance this month depends on the RBNZ endorsing a much steeper path than MUFG expects. A split vote would add volatility either way. Oil is the swing factor beyond today: further gains in crude would add to New Zealand’s fuel-driven inflation and strengthen the case for 3.5% or higher.
